sources.title: Small graphs without power-of-two cycles
sources.author: Daniel Garcia
sources.reported_result: SAT search excluding minimum-degree-three graphs without 4- or 8-cycles through order 23, with DRAT checking.
sources.verification_status: Reported preprint result; not reproduced by Rosetta.

local_assessment: The existing 4-16-vertex random sample is an infrastructure regression sample in previously studied territory. It is not exhaustive replication or frontier research.
future_gate: Disable new erdos-64 assignments until literature, proof/coverage contracts, verifier scalability and resource budgets are reviewed. Cubic graphs have even order; any frontier proposal must also check all realizable power-of-two cycle lengths.
